issue.title: New Project configure review test asserts readiness before the debounced preview settles
issue.description:
Discovered during sase-1lh.7.5 landing on master 4cb33feae9f69561640ea96856f54be00f9856c9.

Master Gate run 38996356739, test (7), job 117289764780 fails
tests/ace/tui/modals/test_new_project_configure_review.py::test_review_back_restores_draft_and_y_stores_model_submission
at line 216: the Review button remains disabled after name.value = "renamed" and
pilot.pause(0.4). URL: https://github.com/sase-org/sase/actions/runs/38996356739/job/117289764780

The same node passes on the identical source SHA locally through
SASE_PYTEST_WORKERS=1 .venv/bin/python tools/run_pytest fast -q
tests/ace/tui/modals/test_new_project_configure_review.py::test_review_back_restores_draft_and_y_stores_model_submission
(1 passed in 7.54s). Observed 1 CI failure and 1 isolated pass; no claim of a
measured general failure rate or repeated serial failure. CI and local environments differ.

The fixture mocks local preview work, but still uses NewProjectConfigure's real
0.3-second debounce. A fixed 0.4-second pause does not prove the timer and subsequent
messages have settled before asserting the button. Replace the premature assertion's
fixed-delay dependency with bounded semantic readiness using the existing test wait
conventions. Preserve the review/back/draft and model-submission assertions; do not
increase sleep durations, disable debounce in production, or weaken the assertions.

Distinct from sase-1l8, which is a visual create-mode provider/name-availability
check that times out after 15 seconds. This is the fast configure/review test with
mocked preview and a 0.4-second precondition. Link them for adjacent ownership.
No active causal New Project epic was found in the in-progress epic sweep;
this release epic never edited this test or its production code.
